assessments.reasoning: GNU’s 3 November 2008 edition at https://ftp.gnu.org/pub/gnu/Licenses/fdl-1.3.txt supplies the §1 definition at [3327,3605) and the two §3 paragraphs at [7115,8127). The latter distinguish the mandatory cover requirement from the recommended overflow layout.

limitations: The license document and its illustrative Addendum cannot establish a particular work’s Cover Texts. The claim does not exhaust §3 or the special placement provisions for aggregates in §7.
reasoning: Edition 1.3 ties the mandatory front- and back-cover placement to publication of more than 100 qualifying copies and to the work’s own notice requiring the passages. The overflow paragraph retains all required texts while advising a particular order and location.
